basic_info.description: Grand Edwardian Home-Step into timeless elegance with this classic Edwardian residence, beautifully proportioned and thoughtfully updated, offering the perfect blend of charm and modern comfort and boasting 4 spacious bedrooms on one level, including a serene primary suite with a large dressing room/sitting area (great space for possible addition of primary bathroom). This home is designed for both everyday living and grand entertaining. The main level features a gracious foyer and a welcoming living room with a Batchelder tiled gas fireplace, beautiful hardwood floors throughout, creating a bright and inviting atmosphere. A generous dining room, cozy den, and a chef's kitchen with stone counters and a breakfast room area with direct access to a deck with stairs to patio/garden provide ample space for gathering. A large garage offers one car parking with an EV charger and expansion potential, featuring a laundry area, workshop space, and ample storage. The beautiful backyard, framed by mature trees, offers a serene and private retreat. This is a rare opportunity to own a home of such scale and character!
